messages.content: Delta canceled the second segment of our Friday outbound and moved us to an itinerary landing Sunday at 9:10 a.m. That costs us the first night and most of another day. What no-cost Saturday arrivals are still available?

There are two. Option one leaves SFO Friday at 11:20 a.m., connects in Atlanta for 4 hours 35 minutes, and reaches SJU Saturday at 12:18 p.m.; total elapsed time is 21 hours 58 minutes. Option two leaves at 9:55 p.m., connects at JFK for 52 minutes, and arrives Saturday at 3:42 p.m.; total time is 14 hours 47 minutes. Delta will exchange either itinerary without a fare difference.
Compare the connection risk and what each does to the Hyatt stay. Include the Sunday rebooking as the baseline.

The Sunday itinerary arrives at 9:10 a.m., after the prepaid February 21 hotel night has passed and roughly 21 hours later than option one. Option one preserves Saturday arrival and gives ample Atlanta connection time, though it requires leaving much earlier Friday and spending a long evening in transit. Option two also preserves the first hotel night, but the 52-minute JFK connection is tight enough that a modest delay from SFO could push you to Sunday. It also reaches the resort about three and a half hours later than option one.
Does option one require an airport change or an overnight hotel in Atlanta?
No. Both flights use ATL, and the connection remains airside in the same airport. The onward flight departs Friday evening, so no Atlanta hotel is needed.
Take option one for both of us. Keep the return exactly as issued and do not change the resort, rental, tour, or massages. Once the tickets are confirmed, move the private arrival transfer to match.

The exchange is confirmed for both travelers at no additional charge: SFO departure Friday, February 20 at 11:20 a.m., Atlanta connection of 4 hours 35 minutes, and SJU arrival Saturday, February 21 at 12:18 p.m. The February 28 return is unchanged. I can now retime the transfer; allowing for checked bags, a 1:15 p.m. pickup is practical.
Change the arrival pickup to 1:15 p.m. Leave the February 28 resort pickup alone.

The private transfer now shows SJU pickup on February 21 at 1:15 p.m. for the revised 12:18 p.m. arrival. The February 28 resort pickup remains 10:45 a.m., and the transfer total remains $356. Hyatt stays confirmed February 21-28, so no prepaid night is lost. The rental, El Yunque tour, massages, and all other resort arrangements are unchanged.
